articles.title: Delhi-Bihar Bus Service Adds 77 Buses With Chhath Fare Relief
articles.summary: The Delhi-Bihar bus service has begun with 77 buses and discounted fares for passengers travelling home for Chhath, offering additional interstate road connectivity to Bihar and eastern Uttar Pradesh during the festival travel period.
